These tiny fonts contain original rectangular outlines authored for PRNext,
under the repository MIT license. They exercise TrueType, OpenType/CFF, WOFF,
WOFF2, TrueType collections, Macintosh data-fork collections and a variable
TrueType font with interpolated widths along its weight axis.

Regenerate with `python tests/fixtures/fontkit/generate.py` after installing
FontTools and its Brotli support in a maintainer environment. Test runners use
the checked-in binary fixtures and need neither Python nor FontTools.
